Name: Project Populate JsonAssets Content Pack Collection
Author: infectmeinjectme
Description:
[left][img]https://i.imgur.com/i0YaCgF.png[/img]﻿

Almost [s]all[/s] of the Content Packs by Project Populate JsonAssets in one convenient place!
[size=6]
[color=#ff0000][b][color=#3c78d8]!!! THIS IS [u]NOT[/u] AN ADDITIONAL CONTENT PACK - THIS SERVES AS A MAIN HUB FOR AN ALL-IN-ON DOWNLOAD !!![/color]
[color=rgb(97, 97, 97)]
[color=#ffffff]IF YOU HAVE ALREADY DOWNLOADED THE MODS INDIVIDUALLY YOU [u]DO NOT[/u] NEED TO DOWNLOAD THIS MEGA PACK

IF YOU DOWNLOADED THIS MEGA PACK YOU MAY NEED TO UPDATE INDIVIDUAL MODS AS TIME PASSES. MAKE SURE TO DELETE THE OLD MODS BEFORE INSTALLING THE UPDATED VERSION.[/color][/color][/b][/color][/size]

[color=#ffffff]I'll probably update this pack about once a month - individual downloads are still recommended
[/color][size=2]Updated: 12/21/2020[/size]

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, Content Patcher (optional), Mail Framework Mod (optional), and SpaceCore.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 7 files included in the download (excluding sub-folders):

[JA] Fantasy Crops
[PPJA] Even More Recipes // 2 Subfolders
[PPJA] Fresh Meat // 4 Subfolders
[PPJA] Fruits and Veggies // 2 Subfolders
[PPJA] Mizus Flowers // 2 Subfolders
[PPJA] More Recipes﻿ // 2 Subfolders
[PPJA] More Trees // 2 Subfolders

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Remove every existing item (crop, clothing, seeds, etc.) excluding items in shops & letters.
Step 2. Remove the corresponding folders.

Forgetting to remove existing items (especially in your inventory) can crash your game.[/left]
